say:1:1013410001:1.text: It's already the dead of night. The old markers have been wrecked by the golems lately. I need to explore to figure out which way to go.
say:1:1013410001:1.source_cn: 夜已经深了，旧日的路标最近被魔偶毁了，我得去探探路，才...

say:2:1013410002:1.text: Oh, but—you guys aren't confident in letting me explore alone, huh?
say:2:1013410002:1.source_cn: 让我看看——喂，你们也不放心让我一个人去探路吧？

say:4:1013410003:2.text: Especially you, Temesia. The way you're looking at me, it's like I'm about to bring back a bunch of bandits to attack here.
say:4:1013410003:2.source_cn: 尤其是特弥希娅。你的眼神，好像我正准备着带回一大帮匪徒...

say:5:1013410004:2.text: You should remember that I never wanted you to guide us on this journey.
say:5:1013410004:2.source_cn: 你应该记得，让你担任向导与我们同行，这从来不是我的意思。

say:6:1013410005:1.text: But now... since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has accepted you as a companion, I feel responsible for keeping an eye on you.
say:6:1013410005:1.male: But now... since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has accepted you as a companion, I feel responsible for keeping an eye on you.
say:6:1013410005:1.female: But now... since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has accepted you as a companion, I feel responsible for keeping an eye on you.

say:7:1013410006:0.text: I bet looking at me is the last thing you wanna do, huh?
say:7:1013410006:0.source_cn: 我还以为，你很讨厌把目光落在我身上呢。

say:8:1013410007:1.text: It's unfortunate, but I have to. Because I'm more aware than anyone else here... that you're not to be trusted.
say:8:1013410007:1.source_cn: 很遗憾我不得不如此。因为我比在场的任何人……都更清楚你...

choice_prompt:9:1013410007.text: It's unfortunate, but I have to. Because I'm more aware than anyone else here... that you're not to be trusted.
choice_prompt:9:1013410007.source_cn: 很遗憾我不得不如此。因为我比在场的任何人……都更清楚你不可信任。

say:12:1013410009:2.text: I'll keep an eye on her. We'll be back shortly.
say:12:1013410009:2.source_cn: 我会看着她的，我们去去就回。

say:15:1013410010:1.text: Ahhh, I really wish I could join them.

say:17:1013410011:1.text: *Laughter* You just want to be part of the drama, don't you, Valen?
say:17:1013410011:1.source_cn: 你是想去看戏吧，维伦。收敛一点好奇心吧！

narration:19:1013410012:0.text: Atalanta and Temesia went ahead to explore, but they didn't return even after a whole night...
narration:19:1013410012:0.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒和特弥希娅前去探路，但一夜未归……

choice:9:1:2.text: Why don't you both go together?
choice:9:1:2.male: Why don't you both go together?
choice:9:1:2.female: Why don't you both go together?
